title: Britain Went To War Over One Ear 👂⚔️
caption:
True story. A captain said Spanish coast guards cut off his ear in 1731, and in 1739 Britain declared the War of Jenkins' Ear. 👂
Would you fight over an ear? 👇
first_comment: One ear, one speech, one war. Is this the dumbest cause for a war ever? 👂👇
